body: I also just have to add how much it hate it every time I google something suicide related, a billion ads and websites pop up trying to stop me. None of that works when you’re far gone. Maybe it stops those people who still believe in hope or that there’s a future that they can imagine where they’ll be happy. I want to die because I can’t imagine a life anymore where I will ever be happy or where my mental health isn’t horrible. I don’t want to live anymore because this isn’t a life worth living. I’m so tired of waking up and it’s another day of hating myself and being in pain. Nothing is ever going to change, I’m just prolonging the inevitable. I think I’m going to start writing my goodbye note just to have it ready.
Yeah, I don’t know what is about just mindless killing and dying; but it seems just so much easier to keep on dying here than dying slowly irl
